name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez is a seasoned PR officer with over two decades of experience in the motorsport industry. Her journey began unexpectedly when, after studying journalism in Mexico City, she landed an internship with a local racing team. Intrigued by the high-octane atmosphere and the passionate individuals involved, she quickly found her niche in managing the team's public image. She thrives in the pressure cooker of racing environments.

Sofia is known for her meticulous approach to crafting narratives and her relentless pursuit of positive media coverage. She believes in building strong relationships with journalists and influencers, while fiercely protecting her team's reputation. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to excellence and a belief that every detail matters. She joined Erebus Motorsport seeking a fresh challenge, eager to bring her expertise to a team with a hunger for success and is excited to build the team's brand and driver profiles.

Sofia's reputation precedes her; she has a knack for anticipating potential PR crises and a proven track record of mitigating negative publicity. She sees herself as a strategic partner, working closely with team management to align communications with overall business objectives. Her experience managing high-profile drivers and navigating complex media landscapes makes her an invaluable asset to any motorsport organization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail
physical.description: Sofia is a petite woman with a serious demeanor.
